analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단 이후 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. 금일 RSI 61.2로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인, MACD 히스토그램 328.2360으로 개선세 지속. 5일 저가 37,300원 대비 현재가 40,110원 상승하며 Higher Low 패턴 형성. SMA5 39,388원, SMA20 37,525원 상회하며 단기·중기 이평선 지지력 확보. 주봉 ADX 27.7로 뚜렷한 추세 유지. 4시간봉 RSI 61.5로 상승 추세 지지.
analysis.reasonEn: After the previous buy signal, a 3-day wait-and-see stance was maintained. Today, RSI at 61.2 confirms exit from oversold territory, and MACD histogram at 328.2360 continues to improve. With the current price of 40,110 KRW above the 5-day low of 37,300 KRW, a Higher Low pattern is forming. Prices are above SMA5 (39,388 KRW) and SMA20 (37,525 KRW), indicating support from short- to mid-term moving averages. The weekly ADX at 27.7 shows a clear trend. The 4-hour RSI at 61.5 supports the uptrend.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met due to RSI exiting oversold and continued MACD improvement.
